title: Connors Double 7s: buy 7-day closing low in uptrend, sell 7-day closing high
rule_summary: Daily signals from closed UTC daily candles built from 1h data; orders executed on the 1h chart at the next open after the daily close. ENTRY when a daily close is above the 200-day SMA of closes AND that close is the lowest close of the last 7 daily closes (including today) AND no position is open. EXIT when a daily close is the highest close of the last 7 daily closes (including today), or the daily close falls below the 200-day SMA (regime exit). Optional hard stop: none in the base rule. Long only, one position, whole balance. Lookbacks: 7 days and 200 days.
mechanism: Short-term overextension: a 7-day closing low inside a long-term uptrend reflects forced selling and impatient liquidations that overshoot; liquidity providers and dip buyers are paid as price mean-reverts to the recent range top. The source gives no formal mechanism, this is the closest honest one (short-horizon reversal after liquidity-driven selling).
